tccolonybridge.configuration.title: TC Colony Bridge
tccolonybridge.configuration.maxRequests: Max requests delivered or crafted per cycle (limits cost per tick).
tccolonybridge.configuration.maxCraftPer: Largest amount sent to autocrafting for one request.
tccolonybridge.configuration.redeliveryC: Wait before serving the same request again, so the courier can pick it up.
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftFailCo: Wait before retrying an item whose craft failed (missing materials, no CPU...).
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftBlackl: Item IDs that are never autocrafted (e.g. "minecraft:diamond_block").
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCrafting: Craft for tag/tool/food requests when the network has no matching item.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftPre: Default for bridges set to "Server default": which item to craft when several match (cheapest, most expensive or preferred list).
Item IDs in order of preference, used by bridges in "Preferred list" mode that have no preferred items of their own.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftVan: Server rule: only Minecraft items for tag requests. Applies to every bridge; bridges cannot override it.
tccolonybridge.configuration.tagCraftMax: Max craftable items compared per request (limits cost on huge networks).
tccolonybridge.configuration.craftCostDe: Recipe levels followed when estimating an item cost (more = more accurate and slower).
tccolonybridge.configuration.statsBucket: Size of each statistics time slot (6000 = 5 min). Changing it resets statistics.
How many time slots statistics keep (288 × 5 min = 24 h). Changing it resets statistics.
tccolonybridge.configuration.supplyMaxPe: Max items each Colony Supply line moves per cycle.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorMaxW: Max width (blocks) of a monitor screen.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorMaxH: Max height (blocks) of a monitor screen.
tccolonybridge.configuration.monitorLink: Max distance (blocks) between a monitor screen and its linked bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.mods.empty: No craftable items in the ME network yet.
gui.tccolonybridge.monitor_hint: Per-request details and statistics are shown on a Colony Monitor linked to this bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.general: Summary of the last cycle. Left bar: crafting on/off, redstone mode and tag craft preference. Per-request details and statistics are shown on a Colony Monitor linked to this bridge.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.filter: Click a slot with an item to copy it (the item stays with you); empty hand or shift-click clears. Shift-click in the inventory copies to the first free slot. You can also drag items from JEI. Left bar: filter mode and comparison.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.preferred: Order used by the "Preferred list" preference: 1st slot first. Empty = the server config list is used. Same controls as the filter.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.mods: Click a mod to mark it. The left bar button chooses how marked mods are used: all, only marked, all except marked or prefer marked. Only mods with craftable items in your ME network are listed.
gui.tccolonybridge.help.supply: Click a slot with an item to choose it; mouse wheel over it changes the amount (Shift ×10, Ctrl ×64). Top row: keep at least this many in the warehouse. Bottom row: anything above this amount goes back to the ME network.
